body:
# Verdict: CHANGES_REQUESTED

- PASS AC-1: fps and quality are validated, persisted with active settings, saved in slots, and restored on slot activation.
- PASS AC-2: Zod defaults load missing fields as 15 and balanced; legacy active and slot settings remain compatible without migration or image loss.
- FAIL AC-3: Quality scaling and image cap are correct, but schedule() performs a direct draw without updating lastDraw, allowing the following RAF to draw before the selected interval.
- PASS AC-4: Draft changes remount CapyPreview immediately and Apply publishes the persisted snapshot to conversation and New thread surfaces.
- PASS AC-UI-1: Controls are compact labeled three-column button groups with help text, keyboard-focusable buttons, aria-pressed, and narrow-width wrapping.
- PASS AC-5: Reduced motion, hidden document, and non-intersection guards prevent or cancel continuous RAF work.
- FAIL AC-6: Focused tests/typecheck/build were observed passing by reviewer, but scheduler/canvas behavior lacks deterministic coverage and local installation evidence is not yet recorded.

## Security / correctness

No security vulnerabilities found. Strict validation and disposal are sound. One frame-cap correctness defect remains: direct scheduling draws do not update lastDraw.

## Design / maintainability

The settings, persistence, preview/apply, and controls fit Aura patterns. Extracting deterministic scheduler and scale helpers would improve regression coverage.

findings.summary: schedule() calls draw() without updating lastDraw, so the next RAF may draw within one selected frame interval.
Tests assert only the quality lookup and do not cover FPS cadence, actual canvas sizing/cap, motion/visibility guards, or preview remount behavior.
Local BB installation and status verification evidence have not yet been recorded.
